title: Topologically induced deformations of differential forms
summary: Motivated by deformations of spin structures and their geometric implications, we study a deformed exterior derivative, which is a third-order nilpotent operator. This higher-order differential structure induces an anholonomic rescaling of the local frame and leads to a bifurcation of the associated cohomological structure, with two distinct notions of closedness and exactness. We prove that the Poincaré Lemma fails in both sectors, so that closed deformed forms need not be exact even locally.
